entries.title: Crimson Sunbird in Morning Light
entries.description: Spotted male bird hovering gracefully to feed on nectar from ginger flowers near Symphony Lake. Vivid iridescent scarlet breast feathers and metallic blue forehead shone brightly in early tropical sun.

entries.title: Massive Crown of Staghorn Fern
entries.description: Perched 12 metres up on a mature Shorea trunk along Chemperai boardwalk. The sterile shield fronds have formed a vast basket trapping falling leaves to generate humus for root nourishment.

entries.title: Malayan Water Monitor Basking
entries.description: Large individual (approx. 1.7m) resting on exposed mangrove mudbank near Main Bridge. Sluggish basking behaviour before sliding smoothly into brackish estuarine water to hunt fiddler crabs.

entries.title: Common Birdwing Butterfly on Lantana
entries.description: Magnificent wingspan fluttering slowly along the Wallace Education Trail edge. The golden yellow hindwings lit up dramatically against dark primary forest undergrowth.
